ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast; approximately 40% high-intensity pixels (white) distributed laterally, 60% low-intensity pixels (black/dark gray) distributed medially.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Bilateral high-intensity regions on distal lobes. Low-intensity central butterfly shape. High-frequency black-on-white mottling at the internal boundaries of the white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch; internal angle approximately 110 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular; right lobe trailing edge shows frequent, high-amplitude serrations; left lobe shows smoother, lower-frequency undulations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe edges follow a convex-upward curve from the peduncle to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white circular spots on the far right lobe tip and upper margin of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct parallel linear scratches on the left lobe white field; several diagonal linear marks in the central dark pigmentation zone.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring consistent with rake marks across the midsection; rough, jagged texture at the distal tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Small, dark, chevron-shaped pigment mark located in the lower-central region of the right lobe's white field.
